comparisons.distinction: Static target-type/tag eligibility applies at target native effect admission. Here current active blocking item vetoes only explicit splash delivery, including instant call interception; same effect via direct/drink path avoids this event. Not a new tag/effect constant.

Applicable plus reverse Added conflict cleanup is global effect-state policy. Here no active-effect cleanup/replacement, only one splash application veto per target/effect; previously present status survives.

Rose combines effect denial and existing wither damage zero with shared cue. Here no later damage gate or dedicated prevent cue; ambient metadata and delivery-specific veto precede both possible instant/noninstant paths.

Cyclic global Applicable may deny all effects or re-add modified instances behind recursive guard and durability. This path has no recursive replacement/payment; veto belongs to splash delivery only. Shared no-beneficial discrimination is not itself new credit.
Region cache with ongoing cleanup differs from live active-stack check at each projectile target; no location cache/tick cleanup or passive inventory protection here.
Stored type grants dynamic target-wide immunity and theft changes storage. Here no stored type/owner/HP or theft; exact effect instance ambient bit is inspected only during this delivery callback.
Vampirism eligibility uses source-player faction and feature package at Applicable; this chain inspects target blocking, not potion thrower, and wraps specific splash calls.

Goety cancellation breaks current-cell entity loop and can repeat across cells. Here cancellation only skips current add-effect call; continues next actual target, no cell break. Shared unconditional bottle-impact cue is support, not separate new credit.

Tinker equips aggregate levels versus amplifier at global admission; this is fresh active-use predicate and ambient flag, no contribution cache/threshold, and not all delivery paths. Coordinator must judge whole delivery-veto mechanism, never count item rename/boolean alone.

dedup_snapshot.limits: Complete stored semantic decisions above actually read; selection screen alone is not uniqueness. Independent coordinator decides whole mechanism max1. No added count for ambient flag, four shields, two hook adapters or impact cue.

migration_overlap_screen.limits: Text screen only, not complete migration semantic proof; migration credit0.

full_chain: TheBetweenlands preInit invokes Registries.preInit, item reflection registers four DentrothystShield variants plus ItemElixir, potion registry binds real effect factories and EntityRegistry registers EntityElixir. init registers ItemDentrothystShield.class. ItemBLShield right-click sets active hand and supplies BLOCK action. Final target.isActiveItemStackBlocking remains a native contract, not assumed from inventory presence.

Actual ItemElixir right-click records sneaking as stack throwing flag then sets active hand. Stop-use with throwing flag constructs EntityElixir on server, copies stack, shoots, attempts spawn then consumes noncreative item regardless spawn return. Throw sound is independent of eventual effect application. Drink-finish and applyEffect directly call addPotionEffect without this custom splash event.

EntityElixir.onImpact server gathers living AABB grow(4,2,4), then distanceSq<16; modifier 1-sqrt(distanceSq)/4 or1 for direct entityHit, still inside distance condition. For each target createPotionEffect resolves metadata/2 effect ID and duration*modifier plus strength, then posts SplashPotionEvent carrying projectile,target,effect,instant metadata. Only if final event.isCanceled is false does that target receive addPotionEffect(effect). Cancellation does not break remaining target loop.

Registered shield subscriber checks target native blocking, actual active stack nonempty and instanceof ItemDentrothystShield; then !effect.getIsAmbient setsCanceled(true). It does not inspect effect bad/beneficial class, green variant, potion owner, instant flag, facing or source distance. No shield-durability, dedicated sound/status/packet, cooldown or retrospective effect removal at this rejection branch.

After normal target iteration, EntityElixir calls world.playEvent(2002,impactPos,color), shard drop2..3, optional rubber ball drop, then setDead, regardless of all events being canceled or no targets. Thus impact-event production and disposal are not success receipts. Exceptions or invalid effect data can exit earlier; no unconditional-finally claim.

Same event also has two CommonHooks methods returning final canceled bit. Full ASM modules accept EntityPotion.applySplash and exact Potion.affectEntity or EntityLivingBase.addPotionEffect instruction descriptors. Insert hook with original local target/effect, IFNE jumps over original call and pops its pending arguments. Noncancel executes original call then jumps past pop block. This wraps each matched effect invocation, not entire splash method return.

Transformer registers both modules, maps obf/deobf names, chooses target slot6/effect12 or Bukkit9/13, mutates instructions once per module success, throws if accepted-class modules never succeed, recomputes frames/max. LoadingPlugin advertises transformer. Packaged coremod manifest and actual transformed 1.12 bytecode were not inspected/executed, so vanilla path is supported static intent, not proved activation. Complete locally visible direct EntityElixir path supplies the real producer/cancel consumer independent of ASM activation.
critical_boundaries: This is application-delivery rejection, not HP damage immunity or universal mob-effect immunity. Holding shield passively is insufficient. No direction/owner filter in this listener, but native blocking readiness/cooldown is external; do not claim immediate protection on right click.

ambient is an instance metadata predicate, not isBadEffect. Ambient true is only not rejected here; other listeners/native target admission can still refuse. Ambient false includes any effect category under this handler. Never infer beneficial protection from variable naming.

Elixir factory uses three-argument PotionEffect constructor; its 1.12 native default ambient implementation was not read. Preserve constructor fact rather than claim all emitted elixirs necessarily nonambient. Four-argument factory overload explicitly accepts ambient, but actual impact path uses two-argument wrapper. No native default completion or package recovery attempted.

Vanilla ASM hook passes local original PotionEffect, not necessarily the scaled/new object already on native call operand stack. Event fields final but effect reference mutable. No guarantee another listener mutating event effect rewrites native pending stack instance. Actual native bytecode/local layout and Bukkit compatibility not verified.

Transformer success only proves matched instruction was instrumented according to source algorithm; modules stop after first match. Native jar manifest plugin activation not verified in fixed manifest, so no blanket all-vanilla-potions/lingering-cloud coverage. Direct drink/apply path explicitly avoids event.

EntityElixir flags instant in event but always calls addPotionEffect when allowed; it does not select affectEntity from that flag. Native handling of instant effects via addPotionEffect unexpanded. Full actual event/helper bodies read; no instant efficacy guarantee.

Effect-ID null/invalid stack or null registry lookup not guarded on impact; valid registered-input branch only. No claim exception still drops bottle. Projectile read/write preserves item only; no attempt ID, refusal cache, retry protocol or dedicated refusal transport.

World event2002 is observed producer call, native packet/render/sound consumer not read; no pixels/audio/server-client runtime guarantee. Existing generic shield attack handler is separate and not invoked by this custom veto. No assets copied/designed.

Entire proposed delivery-scope mechanism at most1, even though four colors/polish, two native hooks, many potion types and registry/helper methods exist. All auxiliary wrappers/metadata/constants0. Independent acceptance required; production remains unchanged.
static_examples_not_executed_tests: Assume valid posted effect, native blocking true and current active DentrothystShield: ambient false makes this listener cancel; ambient true does not. Instant flag true/false makes no difference here.
Two EntityElixir targets A and B: if A event canceled, only A addPotionEffect skipped; B still evaluated. After normal iteration event2002/drop/dead are still attempted even if B also canceled.
Identical effect applied through ItemElixir.applyEffect bypasses this custom event; native effect acceptance still applies. This does not prove simultaneous drinking and shield-use possible.

Vanilla hook canceled: inserted IFNE skips exactly matched invocation and discards pending call operands. Noncancel: original call executes. This is source inspection, not bytecode verification/execution.
application: 效果拒绝原因必须携带真实施加途径与目标，不能把可视元数据当负面类型，也不能用爆裂声光证明命中。投递层取消、目标最终接纳、既有状态存续与HP结算需要分开。仅本地程序参考，不给普通玩家加灰字。
